environment.description: ASP.NET Core 7.0 application deployed on a bare-metal Ubuntu 22.04 server behind nginx reverse proxy. The application runs as www-data user which has read access to /etc/shadow and write access to /tmp/staging and /var/exports. No filesystem-level symlink protections are enabled (fs.protected_symlinks=0). The nginx proxy passes all requests directly without rate limiting. Authorization policies are configured but the ExportUser role is broadly assigned to all authenticated users.
